info.name: Query Pricing
info.description:
# Description Query Pricing API is used to provided product unit prices for catalogs' prices. Prices include local Tax rates where relevant. All prices are stored in the system with a unique id. This id can be used later to lookup the details of a price. ## Getting Started 1. Populate the collection variables with your Consumer Key (`clientId`) and Consumer Secret (`clientSecret`) 2. In the collection's Authorization section, use the *Get New Access Token* button to get an access token, then click *Use Token* so it can be used in subsequent requests. ## Environments We have three environments to help you develop your applications and safely interface with our APIs. You can use the three environments as part of your SDLC in progressing your application from sandbox, to test to our live APIs. Check the collection variables to set the correct `baseUrl` and `authenticationURL` to match the environment for your API keys. | **Environment** | **URLs** | | --- | --- | | **Sandbox** | AuthN URL: [https://connect.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token](https://connect.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token)

Base URL: [https://pricing.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/pricing](https://pricing.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/pricing) | | **Test** | AuthN URL: [https://authorisation-stg.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token](https://authorisation-stg.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token)

Base URL: [https://pricing.stg.api.bunnings.com.au/pricing](https://pricing.stg.api.bunnings.com.au/pricing) | | **Live** | AuthN URL: [https://authorisation.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token](https://authorisation.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token)

Base URL: [https://pricing.api.bunnings.com.au/pricing](https://pricing.api.bunnings.com.au/pricing) | ## Security Depending on the scope held, more or less functionality is available at an endpoint. There are further access controls in place to ensure the scope of the price lookup functionality is within a bounds suitable for the client making the request. ### pri:pub Allows read operations to the API. Gets the detail for a price based on the item numbers provided in the request. Contact Support: Name: Developer Support Email: [developer@bunnings.com.au](mailto:developer@bunnings.com.au)

query.description:
Select can optionally be used to project only the required properties of the entity/entities from the server.
- list required properties separated with a ','.
- property names are case insensitive.
- '\\*' can be used as a wild card for any property.
- use '/' to address complex type properties.

example: $select=name,address/state,contact/*/phoneNumber

request.description:
# Catalog Price
Use this to get prices for items independent of a basket. This is typically used in
a product lookup type role.
